english.note: This is the all-purpose noun phrase for being ready and waiting without taking action yet.

examples.english: In case of an unexpected incident, the relevant departments remain on standby, ready to act.
examples.traditional: 有突發事故時，相關部門會保持待命狀態，隨時投入工作。
